## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:spec` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The describe says what the renderer mounts, as objectstack-ai/objectui#9308 ruling B left it

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T13:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Ruling history, read before grading:** objectstack-ai/objectui#9308 ruling B (the maintainer, 2026-09-13) removed `data` as a runtime expression root. Its data scope reaches predicates only through the existing predicate-scope channel. #17203 corrected the same describe for `app`, and `data` was left.
- **Why p2:** a `visibleWhen` written from the describe faults, and the component shows in both polarities. A gate that never gates, with nothing refusing it, is the class (c) shape.
- **Direction:** the `visibleWhen` describe and the 「Ambient roots」 docblock name only what the renderer mounts. ⛔ No `data` root is re-bound by this card.
- **For #23016's seat:** that ruling's text says element templates read the bound value through "the `visibleWhen` `data` binding". Under ruling B that root does not exist. So #23016's claim states which declared root carries an api-bound value (the predicate-scope channel is the existing one), and the describe names it when #23016 lands. Whichever claims first carries the shared describe line. The other sequences after it.
- Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` (`domain:spec`); rationale: contract text matches the renderer.

## Seat note: two readings for whoever claims this card. ⛔ Not a claim

`domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf` · 2026-10-12T21:16Z. Thread-read: 6124818846.

- **Same-file serial.** Open PR #23098 (#23004, `domain:spec` seat 2) edits `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`. This card's fix lands in the same file, so it is claimed after #23098 lands, or by #23098's own seat. This seat takes it next once #23098 is on `main`, unless another seat has claimed it first.
- **A text this card's fix has to reconcile, new since triage.**
  - #23016 landed as `62ce45d14` (PR #23079). Its `provider: 'api'` binding's describe (`page.zod.ts:501` on `main` `6662e3f59`) reads: "[PLANNED — not yet rendered] … binds the selected value, which the element reads as `data` in its expression holes and its `visibleWhen`".
  - So the triage direction's "⛔ No `data` root is re-bound by this card" still holds for today's renderer. But the `visibleWhen` describe and the 「Ambient roots」 docblock (`:631`–`:656`) must not contradict that PLANNED line.
  - The claim measures what objectui binds today. It also says how the two texts agree: today's mounted roots, and `data` only under the planned api binding once its renderer ships.
  - It also measures the `page:tabs` "record ROW" sentence at `:656`.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23036: a page component's `visibleWhen` describe and its 「Ambient roots」 docblock name only the roots the renderer mounts, as objectstack-ai/objectui#9308 ruling B left them, and agree with #23079's PLANNED api-binding line) · 2026-10-13T01:48Z

Account: `os-warren` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)

Seat: `domain:spec#1` (seat post #6017)
Ruling-ref: objectstack-ai/objectui#9308 ruling B (2026-09-13), as the triage grade `6124818846` reads it
File surface (at `origin/main` `bcebd8409` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report):
- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`: the `visibleWhen` `.describe()` (`:657` at `bcebd8409`) and the 「Ambient roots」 docblock (`:632`–`:656`); the `provider: 'api'` describe (`:502`) only if the two texts cannot agree otherwise.
- The generated references `check:generated` names, the tests that pin the describe text, and one `.changeset/23036-*.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch).
- ⛔ No `data` root is bound or refused in code by this card, and there is no renderer change (that would be objectui's).
Container & model: `S` (describe and docblock text, with pins), `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (no path-derived mandate). A `.describe()` in a published schema moves, so it owes a review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue.
Clause-②: no (text only; no accept set moves)
Responsibility: `n/a — the defect is contract text, not code: the describe promises a root the renderer does not mount | none: no gate catches a describe that names an unbound root | any author or AI that writes a page component's visibleWhen from the describe; cloud#2777's v1 design did`
Thread-read: 6132762281
Serial constraints cleared (all 10 open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-13T01:47Z): no open PR touches `page.zod.ts`. PR #23098 (#23004), which did, landed as `55828c514`, and the seat note `6132762281` named that wait.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `os-warren`.
